published_prior_art.cite: HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM: full-pair LiMVAM identification under correlation-diversity conditions, not a selected-pair exact compatibility frontier.
HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM: no located proper-calibration numerical strictness witness.
ShimizuEtAl2011DirectLiNGAM: one-root recursive residual closure, not a path-independent all-compatible-order removed-set DAG.
HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM: related bivariate correlation-diversity direction criterion.
HauserBuhlmann2014ActiveLearning and LindgrenEtAl2018CostAware: interventional separating-system design rather than passive residual-witness tuple preservation.
HeurtebiseEtAl2026LiMVAM: identifies a partial order under full pairing; the proposed invariant is a direct completion-frontier summary.

ChernozhukovHongTamer2007SetInference gives generic criterion inversion; GhoshalHonorio2018LinearSEM gives singleton-graph recursive finite-sample recovery, neither gives this selected-calibration set map.
GuoPerkovic2021MinimalEffects, WienobstEtAl2023MECEnumeration, and WangEtAl2023EquivalenceEnumeration enumerate different graphical/local equivalence objects.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 / related_work
novelty_flags.one_line: The flagship survey misses Ghassami, Kiyavash, Huang, and Zhang (NeurIPS 2018), which studies multi-domain linear causal discovery with shared structure and varying coefficients/noises; it is not a subsumer because its domains are unpaired, but it is a necessary closest comparator.

soundness_flags.label: ass:centered-gaussian-law
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited LiMVAM source explicitly permits arbitrary disturbance distributions; a jointly Gaussian full law is a stronger maintained restriction, not its standard LiMVAM condition.

soundness_flags.label: ass:disturbance-nondegeneracy
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited source assumes nonzero component variances, not positive definiteness of every full cross-view covariance matrix Γ_j; retag this stronger completion condition as novel and justify it.

soundness_flags.label: ass:marginal-sampling
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited LiMVAM paper treats paired multi-view observations and does not support the separate viewwise-marginal sampling design used by the finite-sample theorem.

soundness_flags.label: ass:cross-variable-disturbance-orthogonality
soundness_flags.one_line: The proposed participant/sensor rationale does not establish that every cross-variable cross-view disturbance covariance vanishes; supply a concrete data-generating application and diagnostic or narrow the claimed empirical destination.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:compatibility-frontier and dependent population statements
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Component alignment is accepted as a maintained, novel restrictive subclass rather than a property of the published full LiMVAM class.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The exact compatibility frontier is claimed only conditional on jointly Gaussian component-aligned LiMVAM laws with positive-definite component cross-view covariance.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:covariance-region-inversion
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Feasibility and path-product separation are accepted as uniform away-from-strata conditions for finite-radius stability.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The displayed Hausdorff and essential-poset guarantees are claimed only on subclasses with δ_feas ≥ κ_feas > 0 and δ_path ≥ κ_path > 0.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2502.20115v4, the exact preprint version named in the bibliography
source_verification_receipts.locator: §3, “A Multi-View Model for Causal Discovery,” and §4.6, “General identifiability using second-order statistics” (source sections content/03_multiview_model.tex and content/04_pairwise_based_estimation.tex).
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The model is X^i = B^i X^i + ε^i with nonzero component variances and within-view independent disturbance components; it explicitly imposes no distributional restriction such as non-Gaussianity. Its correlation-diversity condition and pooled-connectivity condition are separate from a jointly Gaussian law and from Γ_j ≻ 0. The paper assumes paired views, not the proposal's separate marginal-sample design.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Ghassami et al. (2018) to the model comparison and state precisely why paired cross-view covariance plus partial calibration is not reducible to independent multi-domain parameter shifts.

Retag joint Gaussianity, full Γ_j positive definiteness, and the marginal-sampling design according to what the cited source actually establishes; give an independent application-specific justification for every retained novel restriction.

Make component alignment empirically credible by specifying one concrete paired-modality or repeated-measurement mechanism that implies it, an observable falsification diagnostic, and a sensitivity target when it fails.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision on this angle: repair the literature map and assumption taxonomy, then retain the conditional partial-calibration frontier for Stage 0.
